archetypes.name: report-gates
archetypes.rationale: Step 18 final-report emission and sentinel logic is new runtime workflow surface with failure-mode risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine the new Step 18b final-report wrapper and its interaction with write-final-report.sh, token-report.sh, execution-issues logging, and .step17-emitted/.step18-prebody state. Look for stale body emission, suppressed final summaries, bad exit-code propagation, or best-effort failure logging that could hide real cleanup failures. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: bash32
archetypes.rationale: The diff adds Bash runtime and harness code that must remain portable to the repository's Bash 3.2 contract.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review added and changed shell scripts for Bash 3.2 compatibility, safe quoting, local variable behavior, array usage, subshell side effects, and set -euo pipefail interactions. Pay special attention to test harness stubs versus production script behavior where failures may be masked. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: pr-linkage
archetypes.rationale: The Python change centralizes Closes line composition and regex idempotency, which has subtle boundary and import-cycle risks.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the Python PR body and tracking-issue changes around canonical Closes #N insertion, regex idempotency, sanitization order, redaction order, and module dependencies. Check whether exact-match behavior handles punctuation, multiple existing close lines, nonstandard casing, and the intended no-issue path without introducing circular imports. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: surface-sync
archetypes.rationale: Runtime scripts, docs, Makefile targets, and skill prompts changed together and need cross-surface consistency.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the workflow-facing changes across skill prompts, references, helper docs, Makefile targets, and harness registrations. Look for naming drift, stale Step 18 descriptions, unregistered tests, duplicated or contradictory contracts, and runtime surface changes that are not reflected in the shipped plugin metadata. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
